text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum~♪
Hah, hah, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
—Huh.
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu & Pokke
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-chan!
Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I seeee.
The Arima Kinen is right around the corner, after all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
Even on my days off, I just get restless, y'know?
I wanna make up for it at the Arima Kinen, so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Take it back"...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"—The Japan Cup!
You totally outplayed me back then, didn't you."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: She blew past the competition, and that sheer intensity brought the whole crowd to their feet.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ..."Dantsu Flame" was the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: If I heard that back when I first debuted, I wouldn't have believed my own ears!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Back then, I was so busy chasing Tachyon's back that I didn't even notice the beast lurking right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-The beast right next to me!? Eehhh...
I guess you could put it that way.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, to begin with,
you're usually way too floaty and carefree."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even in that game the other day—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I lost! They're crazy strong!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Pokke-san, loser gets swapped out~

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I know that already!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ……Wait, hasn't Dants not done it even once?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even when deciding assignments for the school cleanup—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
And the rest is ditch cleaning, I guess...
Who else was left again?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, me!
I'll clean the ditch~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Even during gym class—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Since our team has 6 members,
1 will be a substitute, right? What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Should I be an alternate?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...W-Was it really that much?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That's right. No matter what you're doing, if you're left alone, you just wander further and further off into left field.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"And yet she's a total beast during races.
Talk about false advertising, seriously."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Well, but precisely because you're like that, you freaked me out—and made me realize I couldn't afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series. You and I have run together
in so many races we could practically get sick of it, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Not even close to enough!
I wanna snatch the title of "The Strongest," too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
So hurry up and make a full recovery, alright?
I'll definitely make sure I don't get injured either!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's keep going at it with everything we've got from now on too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Besties!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To the fist held out straight and without hesitation—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Eh, ah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame hesitantly bumped fists.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"......Huh?
What are you getting so embarrassed for?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I-I'm not blushing!
I'm not blushing at all!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's just, well—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ("Best friends," huh...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.
